dialogues.speaker: Jotun
dialogues.text: Got something you need to say? Give it to me straight; good news or bad news, it doesn't bother me either way.

dialogues.speaker: Jotun
dialogues.text: I'm a hunter. Only sensible choice if you're living in Springvale, right?

dialogues.speaker: Jotun
dialogues.text: Not that it bothers me either way.

dialogues.speaker: Jotun
dialogues.text: Draff tells me what to do and I go do it. Easy peasy.

dialogues.speaker: Jotun
dialogues.text: I cannot be doing with one of them jobs where you have to think for yourself and whatnot.

dialogues.speaker: Jotun
dialogues.text: You're leaving? Not that it bothers me either way, of course...
